features.title: Born with magic
features.text: Your bloodline determines your tradition, extra spells and blood magic effects. Choose a repertoire that fits a damage, healing, control or mixed role.

features.title: Sorcerous Potency
features.text: A generous supply of spell slots and a bonus to slotted spell damage or healing support powerful casting. Bloodline focus spells provide further signature abilities.
